title: Kitso Handshake — common types
description: Shared enums and reusable type definitions for Kitso Handshake v0.1.

ConsentTier.title: ConsentTier
ConsentTier.description: Disclosure policy for a single field or operation. See spec §5 (Consent grammar).

TrustTier.title: TrustTier
TrustTier.description: Verifiability of a claimed agent identity. See spec §6 (Trust tiers).

PrincipalType.title: PrincipalType
PrincipalType.description: What kind of principal an agent represents.

AgentIdentifier.title: AgentIdentifier
AgentIdentifier.description: A stable agent identifier. Recommended pattern: `<namespace>/<role>/<id>` (e.g. `kitsuno.agent/u/seeker_xyz`, `acme.agent/v/eng-42`).

Authorization.title: Authorization
Authorization.description: Per-action authorization granted by a principal to its agent. See spec §5: authorizations are mandatory-TTL, revocable, scope-bounded, and carry an explicit bindability bit.

expires_at.description: TTL is mandatory; protocol forbids standing authorizations without expiry. Defaults: 90 days for general scope, 7 days for invitation-specific.

scope.description: Tasks or fields this authorization covers.

revocable.description: Always true. Revocation MUST be respected within 60 seconds of receipt.

bindability.description: Whether this authorization permits the agent to commit on behalf of the principal, or only to negotiate-and-surface back to the human.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Identity verification basis for an Agent Card. See spec §6.

domain.description: Verified entity domain (when tier is domain_verified).

original_source.description: URI of the public source from which a transient Agent was synthesized (when tier is third_party_attested).

attested_by.description: Identifier of the attesting agent (when tier is third_party_attested).
